title: Proteus Phase 3e ICE repositioning smoke
assertions: Start-of-run Corp actions can move only the source ICE to a different position on the attacked fort.
Using an unrezzed source reveals only that source and keeps other unrezzed ICE hidden in Runner PlayerViews and PublicEvents.
Position, side, stale state and cost drift are revalidated through LegalActions and applyAction.
Replay and StateHash stay stable after same-fort ICE reordering.
